evidence: The surface microroughness measured using atomic force microscopy (AFM) are shown in Fig. 1 after the ALD of silicon nitride on a Si substrate. For comparison, we also measured the surface of silicon nitride deposited on a Si substrate using the conventional low pressure chemical vapor deposition (LPCVD) at 750 °C using SiH2Cl2 and NH3. Here, the thickness of the ALD silicon nitride was 0.9 nm from ellipsometry. The average surface microroughness (Ra) of the ALD silicon nitride [0.023 nm, Fig. 1 (a)] was almost the same as that of the underlying Si substrate (Ra = 0.021 nm).
